business_route.business_question: How does the scene carry gameplay/publish semantics without relying on file naming alone?
business_route.operator_action: Open Asset Protocol Workbench, publish the active payload, then inspect it from Maya Bridge.
business_route.core_logic: Encode role, platform, LOD, collision, and budget into a stable custom attr payload that downstream tools can parse.
business_route.evidence_to_show: Maya node custom attr, inspected protocol rows, DCC evidence JSON.
business_route.reviewer_value: Shows schema ownership and DCC-native metadata strategy.

business_route.business_question: Can the tool turn project rules into repeatable DCC facts, failures, and fix previews?
business_route.operator_action: Run Collect Scene, Validate Scene, Preview Fixes, and Export DCC Report.
business_route.core_logic: Collect scene facts, evaluate deterministic rules, separate safe_auto fixes from manual_only decisions.
business_route.evidence_to_show: Rule results, fix preview rows, rule-matrix artifact.
business_route.reviewer_value: Shows production gate design instead of ad hoc checking.

business_route.business_question: How does subjective art review become a fixed camera/pass contract?
business_route.operator_action: Create the review camera rig, build pass manifest, preview capture, and export review evidence.
business_route.core_logic: Generate canonical cameras and pass rows from the scene so review output can be compared later.
business_route.evidence_to_show: Camera rig nodes, pass manifest, capture preview paths.
business_route.reviewer_value: Shows review standardization and repeatable visual evidence.

business_route.business_question: Can texture handoff be checked against naming, color space, source path, and budget rules?
business_route.operator_action: Create the texture fixture, inspect file nodes, validate the scene, and export the manifest.
business_route.core_logic: Scan shading networks and file nodes, infer texture roles, compare actual color space/path/budget against policy.
business_route.evidence_to_show: Material/file node rows, validation gates, texture-delivery manifest.
business_route.reviewer_value: Shows the bridge between DCC material graphs and engine-facing delivery constraints.

business_route.business_question: Can many scene assets be turned into a dry-run publish queue with receipts?
business_route.operator_action: Discover scene assets, build the queue, run dry-run, and export the report.
business_route.core_logic: Convert discovered assets into protocol/material/texture/visual/export tasks and produce per-asset receipts.
business_route.evidence_to_show: Queue rows, dry-run events, receipts, orchestrator report.
business_route.reviewer_value: Shows how individual tools become a governed production workflow.

business_route.business_question: Can the full asset handoff be judged as a batch instead of five separate demos?
business_route.operator_action: Use Asset Handoff Gate: Fixture, Evaluate Gate, Preview Actions, Export Packet.
business_route.core_logic: Merge protocol, rule, texture, visual and queue evidence into per-asset Ready/Review/Blocked gates.
business_route.evidence_to_show: Handoff asset rows, action preview rows, exported handoff packet.
business_route.reviewer_value: Shows the portfolio has a production workflow, not only individual module proofs.

business_route.business_question: Can the handoff decision explain who owns review rows and what would enter engine import?
business_route.operator_action: Use Asset Handoff Gate / Decision Packet after evaluating the batch gate.
business_route.core_logic: Turn Ready/Review asset gates into repair preview rows, owner disposition rows, and engine import intents without writing to engine.
business_route.evidence_to_show: Decision packet repairPreview, ownerDispositions, engineHandoff rows.
business_route.reviewer_value: Shows the TA boundary between deterministic evidence, owner authority, and engine handoff planning.
